using namespace std;
const int Mod=1e9+7;
typedef long long ll;
ll n;
int m,K,sum,now,a[110];
void ADD(int &x,int y,int m){
	x+=y; if (x>=m) x-=m;
}
struct Matrix{
	int v[35][35];
	Matrix(){ memset(v,0,sizeof(v));}
	Matrix operator*(const Matrix &a) const{
		Matrix res;
		for (int k=0;k<=K;k++)
			for (int i=0;i<=K;i++)
				if (v[i][k])
					for (int j=0;j<=K;j++)
						if (a.v[k][j])
							res.v[i][j]=(1ll*v[i][k]*a.v[k][j]+res.v[i][j])%Mod;
		return res;
	}
} ans,/*hanhan,*/s[75][35],pre[75][35],suf[75][35];
void work(ll n){
	ll tmp=n;
	while (tmp){
		a[++m]=tmp%K;
		tmp/=K;
	}
	reverse(a+1,a+m+1);
}

	scanf("%lld%d",&n,&K);
//	n++; 
	work(n);
	for (int i=0;i<K;i++){
		for (int j=0;j<=K;j++) s[0][i].v[j][j]=1;

	}

		for (int j=K-2;j>=0;j--) suf[i-1][j]=s[i-1][j]*suf[i-1][j+1];
		for (int j=0;j<K;j++)
			if (j) s[i][j]=suf[i-1][j]*pre[i-1][j-1];
			else s[i][j]=suf[i-1][j];
	}
	for (int i=0;i<=K;i++)
		for (int j=0;j<=K;j++)
			ans.v[i][j]=(i==j);
	now=0;

import sys
import math

Mod = 1000000007
K = 0
sum = 0
now = 0
a = [0] * 110

def add(x, y, m):
    x += y
    if x >= m:
        x -= m
    return x

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self):
        self.v = [[0 for _ in range(35)] for _ in range(35)]

    def __mul__(self, a):
        res = Matrix()
        for k in range(K + 1):
            for i in range(K + 1):
                if self.v[i][k]:
                    for j in range(K + 1):
                        if a.v[k][j]:
                            res.v[i][j] = (self.v[i][k] * a.v[k][j] + res.v[i][j]) % Mod
        return res

def work(n):
    tmp = n
    while tmp:
        a[m + 1] = tmp % K
        tmp //= K
        m += 1
    a = a[:m + 1][::-1]

def main():
    global K, m
    n = int(input())
    K = int(input())
    work(n)
    for i in range(K):
        for j in range(K + 1):
            s[0][i].v[j][j] = 1
        for j in range(K + 1):
            s[0][i].v[i][j] = 1
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        pre[i - 1][0] = s[i - 1][0]
        suf[i - 1][K - 1] = s[i - 1][K - 1]
        for j in range(1, K):
            pre[i - 1][j] = pre[i - 1][j - 1] * s[i - 1][j]
        for j in range(K - 2, -1, -1):
            suf[i - 1][j] = s[i - 1][j] * suf[i - 1][j + 1]
        for j in range(K + 1):
            if j:
                s[i][j] = suf[i - 1][j] * pre[i - 1][j - 1]
            else:
                s[i][j] = suf[i - 1][j]
    for i in range(K + 1):
        for j in range(K + 1):
            ans.v[i][j] = (i == j)
    now = 0
    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        if a[i]:
            if now + a[i] - 1 >= K:
                for j in range(now, K):
                    ans = ans * s[m - i][j]
                for j in range(K):
                    ans = ans * s[m - i][j]
            else:
                for j in range(now, now + a[i] - 1):
                    ans = ans * s[m - i][j]
            now = add(now, a[i], K)
    for i in range(K + 1):
        sum = add(sum, ans.v[i][K], Mod)
    print(sum)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
